mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files ( uuid, user_id, user_name, contruction_id, file_name, file_size, file_path, create_time ) VALUES ( (CAST(#{file.uuId} AS UUID), #{userId}, #{userName}, #{contructionId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT uuid as uuId, user_id as userId, user_name as userName, contruction_id as contructionId, file_name as fileName, file_size as fileSize, file_path as filePath, create_time as createTime FROM files WHERE contruction_id = #{contructionId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM files WHERE uuid = CAST(#{uuId} AS UUID)
